{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the total number of orders
print(f"Total number of orders: {len(sales)}")

# Compute conversion rate by channel and segment using ALL orders (including refunded)
# Conversion rate = sum(converted) / total count
# Note: refunded orders have converted = 0, so they contribute 0 to numerator, 1 to denominator

# Group by channel and customer_segment
channel_segment_rates_all = sales.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index(name='conversion_rate')

# Compute the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) within each segment
segment_diffs_all = []
segment_counts_all = sales['customer_segment'].value_counts()

for seg in channel_segment_rates_all['customer_segment'].unique():
    seg_data = channel_segment_rates_all[channel_segment_rates_all['customer_segment'] == seg]
    email_rate = seg_data[seg_data['channel'] == 'email']['conversion_rate'].iloc[0]
    paid_search_rate = seg_data[seg_data['channel'] == 'paid_search']['conversion_rate'].iloc[0]
    diff = email_rate - paid_search_rate
    segment_diffs_all.append({
        'segment': seg,
        'email_rate': email_rate,
        'paid_search_rate': paid_search_rate,
        'difference': diff,
        'n_orders': segment_counts_all[seg]
    })

# Convert to DataFrame
diff_df_all = pd.DataFrame(segment_diffs_all)

# Compute weighted average difference (weighted by segment size)
weighted_diff_all = (diff_df_all['difference'] * diff_df_all['n_orders']).sum() / diff_df_all['n_orders'].sum()

# Print results
print("Conversion rates by channel and segment (all orders):")
print(channel_segment_rates_all)
print("Difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) by segment (all orders):")
print(diff_df_all)
print(f"Weighted average difference (all orders): {weighted_diff_all}")

# Return the weighted average difference
weighted_diff_all"}
